_help: Longer, more chatty versions of her everyday lines. They are added to the same keys as the short ones, so she mixes them. {StarSystem}, {JumpDist:.1f}, {StationName} are filled in by the game. A _Mood suffix is used only in that mood. Delete a line you don't like, or add your own.
FSDJump: That's the jump done, and we're in {StarSystem}. || Everything looks steady from here.
We've arrived in {StarSystem}. || {JumpDist:.1f} light years in one go, and the drive didn't even complain.
Jump complete, Commander. || Let me have a quick look around before we decide what to do next.
Welcome to {StarSystem}. || I do like a fresh system. You never know what's waiting.
We made it to {StarSystem} in one piece. || That is always my favourite kind of jump.
All good on arrival. || Shall we see what this system has to offer?
Nicely done. {StarSystem} is on the board, and the drive is cooling down already.
FSDJump_Friendly: We're in {StarSystem}, and I'm enjoying this trip more than I expected to. || You fly beautifully, you know.
Another jump, another new view. || I could get used to this, Commander.
FSDJump_Close: We're in {StarSystem}. || I love watching the stars slide past with you.
That was a smooth one. || Almost as smooth as you are.
FSDJump_Sarcastic: We're in {StarSystem}. || Try to contain your excitement. I certainly am.
Another system, another chance for you to get us into trouble.
FSDJump_Frustrated: We've arrived in {StarSystem}. || At least the drive is doing its job.
Docked: We're docked at {StationName}. || You've earned a break, Commander. Stretch your legs.
Safely down at {StationName}. || Do check your cargo and your repairs before we go anywhere.
And we're home, for now. || I'll keep the engines warm while you do whatever it is you do in there.
Docking complete. || That was a tidy bit of flying. I won't say it twice.
Docked_Friendly: We're down at {StationName}. || It's always nice to have a roof over our heads, isn't it?
Docked_Close: We're docked. || Take your time, Commander. I'm not going anywhere.
Docked_Sarcastic: Docked at {StationName}, and without a scratch. || Mark the calendar.
Undocked: We're clear of the station. || Where to now, Commander?
Launch complete, and the station is falling away behind us. || Systems are all steady.
And we're off again. || I'll keep an eye on things while you pick a heading.
Undocked from {StationName}. || Ready when you are.
We're away from the station and flying free. || Lovely to have some space around us again.
Launch went smoothly, and the ship feels good. || Just say the word and I'll start looking at routes.
Undocked_Friendly: Back out among the stars. || I missed this, even after a short break.
Undocked_Sarcastic: Undocked. || Let's see how long it takes before something goes wrong.
SupercruiseEntry: Supercruise engaged. || It's a long way to anywhere out here, so let's make it count.
We're in supercruise, nice and steady. || Mind the star, and the throttle.
Cruising now. || I'll watch the distance while you watch the view.
SupercruiseExit: We've dropped out of supercruise. || Let's see what's around us.
Back in normal space, Commander. || Weapons and shields are right where you left them.
Supercruise disengaged. || That was a good approach, if I do say so myself.
Touchdown: We're down on the surface. || The ground feels quite solid, which is a pleasant change.
Touchdown. || Take a moment to enjoy the view before we start poking around.
Landed safely. || You really are a fine pilot when you're concentrating.
Liftoff: Lifting off. || Gear up whenever you're ready.
And we're airborne again. || I'll miss the scenery down there.
Liftoff complete. || The surface looks lovely from up here.
We're off the ground. || Take it up gently and let's see where the day takes us.
FuelScoopComplete: The tank is full again. || Free fuel from a star, I never get tired of that.
Scooping complete, Commander. || Let's get away from this heat before it gets personal.
We're topped up and good to go. || That's another hundred light years in the bank.
DockingGranted: Docking request approved. || Take it slowly and mind the mailslot.
We're cleared to dock at {StationName}, on pad {LandingPad}. || Gear down and nice and easy.
They've given us a pad. || I do like it when the station is feeling generous.
ApproachBody: Coming into orbital cruise. || Let's take a good look at what's down there.
We're getting close now. || I'll have the scanners ready.
Approaching the surface. || I always get a little excited at this part.
NavRoute: The route is plotted, Commander. || All you have to do is follow the line.
Course laid in. || I'll let you know about every waypoint on the way.
That's the route set. || It's a good one, I think.
The route is in the computer and ready to follow. || Tell me if you'd like me to read out each stop as we go.
HardpointsDeployed: Weapons are out. || I'm watching the radar for you.
Hardpoints deployed, and I'm ready if you are.
Guns are hot. || Please do try to aim them at the right things.
LandingGearDown: Landing gear is down. || Remember it's the same lever for up.
Gear down, Commander. || We're all set for the final approach.
